findings.title: The F-DG1-217 repair handles only part of TypeScript's declaration-file names. apps/api/src/architecture.testkit.ts:445 has DECLARATION_FILE = /\.d\.[cm]?ts$/, so syntaxErrors() (:477-484) sends only *.d.ts / *.d.mts / *.d.cts to the no-emit declarationSyntaxErrors() (:455). TypeScript's own ts.isDeclarationFileName() is also true for the arbitrary-extension form <name>.d.<ext>.ts, e.g. styles.d.css.ts, data.d.json.ts or x.d.ts.ts (allowArbitraryExtensions declaration files). walk() still collects these names via CODE_FILE (:182), and they still reach ts.transpileModule, which throws the same internal 'Debug Failure. Output generation failed'. The lint therefore still crashes, with no file name in the message, on these declaration files.
findings.reproduction: Candidate sha256:76d8b304...7846, full disposable clone at f27b5a6f, Node v22.22.2 and v24.21.0, TypeScript 6.0.2. Probe docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG1/code-security/round-15/zz-r15-probe.test.ts.txt, copied into the clone as apps/api/src/zz-r15-probe.test.ts. (1) fileViolations('transformations', <MODULES_DIR>/transformations/zz.d.css.ts | zz.d.json.ts | zz.d.ts.ts, 'export declare const x: number;') throws 'Debug Failure. Output generation failed', and so does a deep cross-module type import. ts.isDeclarationFileName() returns true for all three names, and walk() returns all three from a planted directory (01-/01b- logs). Controls: zz.d.ts/.d.mts/.d.cts are handled correctly, and zz.d.tsx and zz.D.TS are not declaration names and are linted normally. (2) End to end: planting apps/api/src/modules/transformations/zz-r15.d.css.ts in the clone makes architecture.test.ts 'every import respects dependsOn, public surfaces and allowed packages' fail with '-> Debug Failure. Output generation failed', exit 1 (02-planted-d-css-ts-architecture.log). (3) After pnpm -r build, tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.build.json emits nothing for that file (03-dts-emit-after-build.log), so it carries no runtime code into dist.
findings.expected: Every file TypeScript treats as a declaration file is linted without an internal compiler assertion, as F-DG1-217's expected result asks for 'a declaration file in a module'. A violation or syntax error should be a named lint diagnostic. Simplest fix: decide with ts.isDeclarationFileName(fileName) instead of the hand-written regex, or widen the regex to /\.d\.([cm]?ts|[^.]+\.ts)$/. Add a self-check case for e.g. zz.d.css.ts.
findings.actual: The lint fails closed for <name>.d.<ext>.ts files: CI goes red and nothing slips past the boundary check. But the error is an opaque 'Debug Failure' instead of a named diagnostic, which is the defect class F-DG1-217 described. The real module tree has no declaration files (find apps/api/src -name '*.d.*' gives 0), so no current check is red. Rated Low and non-mandatory: lint-tooling robustness only, with no access-control, integrity, calculation or portability impact, and no way to bypass the check.

history.note: Raised by code-security-reviewer in DG1 round 15 (session 32298593) while re-proving F-DG1-217. It is a residual of the same defect class, in names the F-DG1-217 reproduction did not list. Low and non-mandatory: fail-closed lint robustness, with no product impact. Suggested fix: use ts.isDeclarationFileName() in syntaxErrors(). The ID is proposed from the code-security F-DG1-1xx block (next after F-DG1-136); the orchestrator may re-allocate it.
